images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied original whole-island city concept as a substantially DARKER AND MORE VIBRANT colour exploration. Preserve the precise island composition, flat terrain, coastline, big downtown, campus at far left, docks at lower right, foreground large shops and surface car parks, curving street layout, individual building footprints and camera framing. Do not add or remove districts or change road geometry.
The current image is too naturalistic, pale and muted. Make a bold stylized game-art colour pass, visibly different, not a subtle filter. Keep recognizable ordinary architecture but smooth and simplify tiny surface detail. Replace most pale ivory/tan facades with rich saturated teal, cobalt, muted aubergine, deep blue and burgundy. Downtown should have deep indigo and petrol towers with luminous-colour cobalt/turquoise/coral architectural panels (paint, NOT glowing sci-fi stripes). The old port quarter has dark plum roofs, dusty-violet walls and vivid hot-coral storefront accents. The housing quarters mix royal blue, teal and brick-magenta buildings, never a sea of cream houses. Campus retains warm burnt-orange brick with deep blue roofs and green fields. The retail park has dark blue and plum large roofs and strong cyan/yellow/coral facades. The docks have emerald/indigo sheds with coral cranes and amber/cobalt accents. Roads and car parks are QUIET dark blue-charcoal with sparse understated grey lane/bay markings; bright tiny cars still stand out. Water is very deep blue-teal. Trees are sparse simplified dark teal-green masses, not bright realistic leaves.
Light is fixed overcast DAYTIME, not twilight or night: cool diffuse fill lights every street and deep shadow, soft broad highlights, soft readable shadows, no blacked-out targets. Rich dark material values balanced with intense pigment colour, not underexposure. No glowing windows, luminous street lines, orange sunset, neon bloom, fog obscuring streets or photoreal texture grain. Smooth bevels and clean broad surfaces, original stylized 3D art, no pixel art. No text, labels, logos, extra objects, real brands or UI. Output landscape at least 1600 px wide.
